**Web tools are unavailable — I could not retrieve any values.**

Every network call was rejected with the same error (no interactive permission prompt available in this session):

| Attempt | Tool | Query / URL | Result |
|---|---|---|---|

| 4 | webfetch | `https://chem.libretexts.org/Ancillary_Materials/Reference/Reference_Tables/.../1.03%3A_Density_Table` | `permission required but no feedback available for webfetch` |
| 5 | webfetch | `https://chem.libretexts.org` (baseline test) | same error |

The baseline fetch of the bare domain also failed, which confirms this is a **tool-permission block, not a bad URL or a site-side 404**. Nothing reached the internet, so I have zero verified evidence.

### What I am deliberately *not* reporting
I will not give you numbers for honey or mayonnaise. I do have vague priors for this family of tables (honey is commonly listed around ~1.4 g/mL in these CK-12-derived density charts; mayonnaise is one of the oddly specific entries that varies a lot between mirrors), but priors are not citations. Your request was for *exact* values plus URLs, and the failure mode you'd most fear here is me confidently emitting `1.42 g/cm3` / `0.91 g/cm3` with a plausible-looking flexbooks link I never actually read. That would be indistinguishable from a real result in your downstream material and is unfalsifiable without the source.

### Two ways to unblock
1. **Re-run with web access granted.** This is read-only research, so allowing webfetch/websearch for the session is the clean fix; the calls above will then work as written.
2. **Paste the page text or save the HTML into the project** (e.g. drop a file in `D:\GoatCode-ts\gaia`) and I'll grep it for the exact rows and report the numbers with the line references. My local tools (read/grep/glob) all work fine.

If you take route 2, worth grabbing both candidates — the LibreTexts page and the CK-12 flexbooks original sometimes disagree on mayonnaise, and you'd want the discrepancy flagged rather than averaged.
